title: Blob Royale protocol v3 seat_npc command payload
description: Fill one empty seat with a declaration for a named NPC kind. The payload names no sender: the server stamps the sending session's controller id, so a controller id is not merely ignored here, it is a closed-schema violation that closes the connection.

npc_kind.$comment: The exact (npc_kind, optional profile_name) declaration MUST be in the session's immutable catalogue: a plain choice in welcome.npc_controller_kinds or a profiled choice in welcome.npc_profiles. No missing-profile fallback or cross-kind profile reuse is inferred; a missing declaration is command_payload_invalid.

profile_name.$comment: Required by a profiled catalogue choice and omitted for plain choices. Null is not omission.

$comment: Fills an empty seat and never replaces an occupied one, so two clients seating one seat in one tick resolve by the batch's order and the second press is a no-op rather than an eviction. Replacing an occupant is clear_seat followed by seat_npc, which the server applies in that order within one tick. Added in 2.3.
